# Frozen on-disk format of the disk log (FormatVersion 1). Until the first release a change replaces a line in place; after it, a change needs a FormatVersion bump.
# Each line is a header's bytes in hex; the encoder zero-pads them to the end of the block.
# superblock: log ID 0x0123456789abcdef on a 1 GiB disk (256 KiB segments, 4,096 of them).
# segment_header: the same log, open sequence 7, segment 3, cold, manifest at segment 2 block 9 LSN 41.
# segment_header_meta: open sequence 8, segment 4, metadata, lane 0, the same manifest.
# segment_header_merge: open sequence 9, segment 5, metadata, lane 3 (merge worker 3), the same manifest.
# record_header: the same log, segment sequence 9, offset 1, LSN 10, durable LSN 9: a 1-block write (pool 1, chunk (2,3,4),
#   version 5, block 6, data 0xAB), a whole-chunk punch (version 6) and a 3-byte manifest blob ("abc", owner 7).
superblock 52534f4c49445342010000007b00dcf3efcdab89674523014000000000100000
segment_header 52534f4c4944534701000100e4e4ffceefcdab896745230107000000000000002900000000000000030000000200000009000000
segment_header_meta 52534f4c4944534701000200377d36a8efcdab896745230108000000000000002900000000000000040000000200000009000000
segment_header_merge 52534f4c494453470100020333b6cbf5efcdab896745230109000000000000002900000000000000050000000200000009000000
record_header 525352430100010048384d5d01000000efcdab896745230109000000000000000a000000000000000300000002000000090000000000000001010000000000000200000000000000030000000405000000000000000600010002010000000000000200000000000000030000000406000000000000000000000404040700000003000000000000009341379405731b8c
